name: Rust WASM toolchain for @doenet/math
description: Adds the wasm32 target and a version-matched wasm-bindgen-cli, which @doenet/math needs to compile the math-expressions Rust core.

wasmBindgenVersion.description: Must equal the wasm-bindgen crate version pinned in vendor/math-expressions/packages/math-expressions-rs-wasm/Cargo.toml. The CLI and the crate are checked against each other at build time and a mismatch is a hard error.
